what_this_is: Measured facts about the demo film, which is not in this repository. The file is held outside it and no public link is published here until there is one to publish. The numbers are what ffprobe and ffmpeg's loudness meter read off the finished file, written by the script that produced it. That script is outside this repository too, for the same reason the film is, so this file is the whole of what a reader here can check: the hash below identifies the exact file the numbers were taken from.
why_it_is_here: Three surfaces carried a running time typed by hand and a re-render moved the cut by five seconds, so all three were wrong at once.
narration_note: The greeting is a recording of the author. Every other line is a voice clone of the same speaker, conditioned on twenty-two seconds of him reading aloud, and rendered one sentence at a time. Each sentence is generated up to twenty times off a fixed seed sequence and the take kept is the one nearest 4.0 syllables a second, so the pace is chosen at the microphone rather than imposed afterwards: what is left is corrected by at most seven percent, which is the width at which a time stretch stops being audible. Syllables rather than words because words are the wrong unit: normalised onto one word rate, these lines still ran between 3.15 and 4.58 syllables a second, since a line of short words scores fast and gets slowed while a line of long words scores slow and gets hurried. The rate below is read back off the finished files. The call in act one is real, from the recording CALL-E returned, played in one unbroken cut.
